table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.receiptinvcode,   
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.salesmancode,
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.DeptCode,   
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.date,
	Source = 
		CASE dbo.ReceiptHeader.RecipientCode 	
		WHEN 1 THEN (SELECT D.Name FROM Department D WHERE D.DeptCode=dbo.ReceiptHeader.DeptCode)
		WHEN 2 THEN (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode=dbo.ReceiptHeader.AccCode)
		WHEN 3 THEN (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode=dbo.ReceiptHeader.AccCode)
		ELSE (SELECT S.Name FROM Salesman S WHERE S.SalesmanCode=dbo.ReceiptHeader.RecipientSalesMan)
		END,	

	salesmanname = dbo.users.username,
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.postdate,   
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.remarks,   
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.posted, 
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.originaldate,
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.modifiedby,
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.postedby,
	gcode=0,
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.headerno,
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.headerinvno,
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.AreaCode,
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.SManCode,
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.ReferenceNo,
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.ReferenceDate,
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.RecipientCode,
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.AccCode,
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.RecipientSalesMan,
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.PriceTypeCode,
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.WorkOrderCode,
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.ReceiptCategoryCode,
	CrAccount = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode=dbo.ReceiptHeader.CrAccCode),
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.AccountFor,
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.CrAccCode,
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.ReceiptCode,
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.QE1_AccCode, 
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.QE2_AccCode, 
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.QE3_AccCode, 
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.QE4_AccCode, 
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.QE5_AccCode, 
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.WE1_AccCode, 
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.WE2_AccCode, 
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.WE3_AccCode, 
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.WE4_AccCode, 
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.WE5_AccCode,
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.QExp1_CrAccCode, 
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.QExp2_CrAccCode, 
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.QExp3_CrAccCode, 
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.QExp4_CrAccCode, 
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.QExp5_CrAccCode, 
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.WExp1_CrAccCode,
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.WExp2_CrAccCode, 
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.WExp3_CrAccCode, 
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.WExp4_CrAccCode, 
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.WExp5_CrAccCode

FROM 
	dbo.ReceiptHeader,
	dbo.users
WHERE 
	dbo.users.usercode = dbo.ReceiptHeader.salesmancode and 
	dbo.ReceiptHeader.receiptinvcode = :ar_receiptInvCode
